findings.where: js/three/buildings3d.js near mode (_nearUpdate line 168, _loadGroup, _compile line 189) on low / medium tiers; landside.glb 20.34 MB
findings.problem: Near mode was meant to keep phones light, but on the low tier landside.glb loads from every core camera, and its phone cost has never been measured. Low-tier LOD2 switches scale by 1000/1800 = 0.556, so the near trigger is 1500 x 0.556 x 1.1 + 60 = 984 m. Every probe (tower cab; gates A1, B2, C3, D10, E10, G10; ITB west) has 10-16 landside units inside that distance, so the 20.3-MB file is fetched and parsed. That file carries LOD0 162,038 tris + 93,420 instanced, LOD1 81,462 + 65,740, LOD2 15,552 and 1,732 cars. _compile() forces every LOD visible with frustumCulled=false, and a full file is never released once loaded.
